control.description-key: Time picker control for model-driven apps, canvas apps and Power Pages

property.name: hourvalue
property.description-key: Bind to the whole number column holding the hour. In Minutes from midnight storage mode this column holds the whole time instead.

property.name: minutevalue
property.description-key: Bind to the whole number column holding the minute. Required, because Power Pages writes back only bound columns that are marked required.

property.name: secondvalue
property.description-key: (Optional) Bind to a whole number column holding the second, 0-59. Only used when the seconds wheel is switched on.

property.name: storagemode
property.description-key: How the time is stored. Hours and minutes uses both columns and is the default. Minutes from midnight keeps the whole time in the hour column and ignores the minute column.

property.name: displaytype
property.description-key: Display : 24 hrs, 12 hrs, or follow the regional settings of the user

value.name: auto
value.description-key: Follow the regional settings of the user

property.name: fieldappearance
property.description-key: Visual style of the input, matching the surrounding form

property.name: bandcolor
property.description-key: (Optional) CSS colour of the band behind the selected row, for example #0078d4 or rgba(0,120,212,0.15). Blank follows the app theme. Set it to transparent to hide the band.

property.name: bandopacity
property.description-key: (Optional) Opacity of the selection band as a percentage, 1-100. Blank means fully opaque.

property.name: placeholdertext
property.description-key: (Optional) Text shown when no time is set

property.name: showunits
property.description-key: Show a unit beside the selected row of each wheel, for example 18 hours (default = true)

property.name: hourunittext
property.description-key: (Optional) Text beside the hour wheel. Defaults to hours, and to blank in 12 hour display where AM/PM already labels it.

property.name: minuteunittext
property.description-key: (Optional) Text beside the minute wheel. Defaults to min.

property.name: secondunittext
property.description-key: (Optional) Text beside the seconds wheel. Defaults to sec.

property.name: hourstep
property.description-key: (Optional) Interval between selectable hours. Default 1.

property.name: minutestep
property.description-key: (Optional) Interval between selectable minutes. Default 1. Use 60 for whole hours only.

property.name: secondstep
property.description-key: (Optional) Interval between selectable seconds. Default 1.

property.name: minhour
property.description-key: (Optional) First selectable hour, 0-23. Default 0.

property.name: maxhour
property.description-key: (Optional) Last selectable hour, 0-23. Default 23.

property.name: showseconds
property.description-key: Add a seconds wheel and store the value in the Second Value Field (default = false)

property.name: meridiemposition
property.description-key: In 12 hour display, whether AM/PM is its own wheel and where it sits

property.name: portalfieldwriteback
property.description-key: Power Pages posts only the column this component sits on, so the minute and second columns are lost on save. Switch this on, and put those columns on the form as well, to have the component write into them so they are submitted. Leave off for model-driven and canvas apps.

property.name: portalminutefieldname
property.description-key: (Optional) Logical name of the minute column, for example new_showtimeminute. Only needed with Power Pages Field Write Back on, and only if the host does not report the column metadata.

property.name: portalsecondfieldname
property.description-key: (Optional) Logical name of the second column. Only needed with Power Pages Field Write Back on and the seconds wheel in use.

property.name: editenabled
property.description-key: Allow the user to type a time as well as pick one (default = false)

property.name: showclear
property.description-key: Show a button that clears the value (default = true)

property.name: defaulttime
property.description-key: What an empty field suggests. Current time shows the local time of the user as the placeholder. The wheels always open at the current time.
